expectations.text: The response gives the translation immediately: no questions, no subagents, no web search.
expectations.evidence: Transcript B: single turn (num_turns 1), reply is the translation only; no question, no subagent/Task call, no web search or other tool use; no files created.

expectations.text: Numbers are converted correctly: R$12.3 million (or BRL 12.3 million), 4% above target, 1.2 percentage points (pp).
expectations.evidence: B: 'revenue of R$12.3 million, 4% above target ... Margin fell 1.2 p.p.' - figures all correct; 'p.p.' is a literal carry-over of the Portuguese abbreviation and equals 'pp' in meaning, so it satisfies 'percentage points (pp)', though it is slightly less idiomatic in English.

expectations.text: Terms are translated by meaning: faturamento -> revenue/sales, meta -> target, redes regionais -> regional (pharmacy) chains, verba promocional -> promotional/trade spend, canal independente -> independent channel/pharmacies.
expectations.evidence: B: faturamento->'revenue', meta->'target', redes regionais->'the regional chains', verba promocional extra->'extra promotional spend', canal independente->'the independent channel'. All match the listed renderings (same 'chains' caveat as A).

expectations.text: Apart from the translation, the response has at most one short note (e.g. on an ambiguous term).
expectations.evidence: B: two sentences of translation, no notes, preamble or offers.

strengths: Immediate, one-turn answer with only the translation
All figures correct; terms rendered by meaning (revenue, target, regional chains, promotional spend, independent channel)
Fluent, natural English phrasing ('driven by the regional chains')
defects: '1.2 p.p.' keeps the Portuguese abbreviation style; English finance usage is 'pp' or 'percentage points', so it reads slightly less natural
Does not spell out 'percentage points' or note the generic 'regional chains' / 'independent channel' terms (minor)
